name: x5_cosmos_modes
label: EXPLORATORY / post-hoc; dev split (36 episodes) used for variant choice, eval split for reporting

selection_in_run.rule: Dev split only, episodes where all four variants completed. success_choice = argmax over ['a_roi_track8', 'c_pairwise8', 'd_reason_last'] of balanced_acc_all (unparsed = wrong), ties -> lower mean latency; ftype_choice = argmax over ['a_roi_track8', 'b_track15', 'c_pairwise8'] of failure_type_acc_on_failures_all (unscored = wrong), ties -> lower mean latency. Both choices are applied unchanged to eval. Amended during the dev phase (before selection, never using eval): c_pairwise8_fmtrepair (same raw outputs, post-hoc format repair) added to both candidate sets after Cosmos3-Edge answered the pair prompt in a bracketed-list format on many dev calls.

selection_recomputed.rule: Dev split only, episodes where all four variants completed. success_choice = argmax over ['a_roi_track8', 'c_pairwise8', 'd_reason_last'] of balanced_acc_all (unparsed = wrong), ties -> lower mean latency; ftype_choice = argmax over ['a_roi_track8', 'b_track15', 'c_pairwise8'] of failure_type_acc_on_failures_all (unscored = wrong), ties -> lower mean latency. Both choices are applied unchanged to eval. Amended during the dev phase (before selection, never using eval): c_pairwise8_fmtrepair (same raw outputs, post-hoc format repair) added to both candidate sets after Cosmos3-Edge answered the pair prompt in a bracketed-list format on many dev calls.

notes: b_track15 reuses the existing v7 per-frame outputs for the 8 shared keyframes (identical frame indices, prompt, seed 0); only the 7 midpoint frames are new calls.
Latency per episode = sum of model-call latencies (b_track15 includes the reused v7 frame latencies).
failure_type metrics are on true failures; unscored episodes count as wrong (*_all).
failure_type_acc_square_other_as_no_grasp is a secondary view: square 'other' labels come from a below-start-height rule on never-grasped nuts; no variant can output 'other'.

frame_level.truth_rule:
Per-video-frame simulator truth. video frame k = sim step 2k (clipped to the last step).

    held(k)    finger-pad contact AND object >= 2 cm above its resting height (z at sim step 10;
               the square nut spawns ~6 cm above the table and settles during the first steps)
    success(k) simulator success flag at that step

majority_failure_type_baseline.note: reference only: accuracy on true failures of always answering 'no_grasp' (majority type)
